tables.description: One row per major star, palace and earthly branch: the brightness the star has at that branch and the site's reading of the star in that palace, with the classical passages the reading engine looks up for it.
One row per minor star (or the void markers Tuần and Triệt) and palace, as met on real charts, with the classical passages looked up for the star in that palace.
One row per star: how the site places it (minor stars) and the classical passages about the star itself.
One row per transformation (Hóa Lộc, Hóa Quyền, Hóa Khoa, Hóa Kỵ) with the classical passages about it.

One row per named chart pattern the engine recognizes: the site's description, the annotation of the Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư where it lists the pattern, and the classical passages under the pattern's name.
